Now, the current case: illegal possession of firearm (非法持有枪支) and possibly illegal possession of ammunition (非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药). The facts mention "非法持有一把双管火药猎枪" and "自制火药实弹39发". So we should output that.

Also, maybe "非法买卖弹药罪" is previous conviction, not current. So only current charge is illegal possession of firearms and ammunition.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药<eoa>
